acceptable_source_span_rule.BLOB_OR_UNSUPPORTED: no acceptable source spans under A1 exact-span materializer
acceptable_source_span_rule.INTEGER: all strict numeric literal spans whose full literal parses losslessly to the gold integer
acceptable_source_span_rule.REAL_OR_NUMERIC: all strict numeric literal spans whose full literal parses to the gold finite numeric value
acceptable_source_span_rule.TEXT: all exact occurrences of the gold text in the exact original question

matching_policy: maximum-cardinality bipartite matching from accepted predicted spans to gold assignments
multi_occurrence_policy: all acceptable source occurrences are retained as alternatives before model output exists
numeric_partial_substring_policy: numeric matches must consume a full regex numeric literal; a single digit inside a longer numeric literal is not an acceptable span
